Who We Are?

Taifa Technovation Hub is the first Maker-space in Iringa, Tanzania, offering tomorrow's innovators the best hands-on learning experiences. Our robust suite of learning tools stimulates creativity and innovation.

We enable learners to transform their best ideas into creative solutions that bring about positive change with local and global impact.
